localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 门户前端资源构建任务。

name: portal-login-password-encryption
summary: Login-password pre-submit encryption helper for the legacy Portal login flow.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 登录密码提交前加密助手；保留 IE6 级语法兼容，并只向页面暴露最小的加密入口。
localizedSummaries.en: Login-password pre-submit encryption helper; it keeps IE6-level syntax compatibility and exposes only the minimal encryption entry points to the page.

name: closeWatchers
summary: Stops every active Gulp watcher and clears its in-memory handle.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 停止全部活动的 Gulp watcher，并清空对应的内存句柄。
localizedSummaries.en: Stops every active Gulp watcher and clears its in-memory handle.

name: coffeejs
summary: Builds CoffeeScript source files to minimized JavaScript with source maps.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 构建 CoffeeScript 源文件，输出压缩后的 JavaScript 及 source map。
localizedSummaries.en: Builds CoffeeScript source files to minimized JavaScript with source maps.

name: esjs
summary: Builds ES module source files from `*.src.js` to minimized JavaScript with source maps.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 构建 `*.src.js` ES 模块源码，输出压缩后的 JavaScript 及 source map。
localizedSummaries.en: Builds ES module source files from `*.src.js` to minimized JavaScript with source maps.

name: postcssProcessors
summary: Creates the PostCSS processor chain shared by Sass asset builds.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 创建 Sass 资源构建共用的 PostCSS 处理器链，负责补全浏览器前缀并压缩 CSS。
localizedSummaries.en: Creates the PostCSS processor chain shared by Sass asset builds.

name: sasscss
summary: Builds Sass and SCSS source files to prefixed and minimized CSS with source maps.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 构建 Sass 与 SCSS 源文件，输出补全前缀、压缩后的 CSS 及 source map。
localizedSummaries.en: Builds Sass and SCSS source files to prefixed and minimized CSS with source maps.

name: startWatch
summary: Starts the Visual Studio Task Runner watchers without performing an initial asset build.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 启动 Visual Studio Task Runner 使用的 watcher，不执行首次资源构建。
localizedSummaries.en: Starts the Visual Studio Task Runner watchers without performing an initial asset build.

name: stopWatch
summary: Writes the watcher signal file so the active Visual Studio watcher process exits gracefully.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 写入 watcher 信号文件，使活动的 Visual Studio watcher 进程正常退出。
localizedSummaries.en: Writes the watcher signal file so the active Visual Studio watcher process exits gracefully.

name: createRequest
summary: Creates an XMLHttpRequest-compatible object for the current browser.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 按现代接口、Msxml2.XMLHTTP、Microsoft.XMLHTTP 顺序创建请求对象；均不可用时返回 null。
localizedSummaries.en: Creates a request object in the order native API, Msxml2.XMLHTTP, then Microsoft.XMLHTTP; returns null when none is available.

name: encryptPassword
summary: Adapts one password pair to the batch encryption routine.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 将单个密码控件对适配到批量流程，保持单字段入口与多字段入口使用同一失败和明文清理语义。
localizedSummaries.en: Adapts one password-control pair to the batch flow so single-field and multi-field entry points share the same failure and plaintext-clearing semantics.

name: encryptPasswordFields
summary: Encrypts one or more page password fields and commits ciphertext only after the whole batch succeeds.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 校验成对字段、按需读取公钥并先完成整批加密，再一次性写入密文并清空明文；任一准备或加密失败都保留未提交的明文值供页面重试。
localizedSummaries.en: Validates field pairs, fetches the public key only when needed, encrypts the complete batch first, then commits ciphertext and clears plaintext; any preparation or encryption failure leaves uncommitted plaintext available for a page retry.

name: getById
summary: Resolves a page element by its DOM id.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 按页面集成提供的 DOM id 查找元素；找不到时返回 null，不创建或修改元素。
localizedSummaries.en: Resolves the element identified by the page integration's DOM id; returns null when it is absent and never creates or mutates an element.

name: requestPublicKey
summary: Fetches the public key text used for one synchronous encryption pass.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 以同步 GET 读取页面指定的公钥端点并加入时间戳避免缓存；本函数不验证 URL 来源，来源信任由页面集成负责。
localizedSummaries.en: Reads the page-selected public-key endpoint with a synchronous GET and cache-busting timestamp; URL-origin validation remains the responsibility of the page integration.

name: setMessage
summary: Writes a fixed login-preparation message into the page message element.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 将本助手选择的固定提示写入页面消息元素；不承担通用 HTML 净化或错误详情展示。
localizedSummaries.en: Writes the fixed message selected by this helper into the page message element; it is not a general HTML sanitizer or error-detail renderer.

name: assetsBuild
summary: One-time asset build task for VSCode and AI automation. It processes only existing source globs, writes outputs beside them, and does not create input directories or change the Visual Studio `startWatch` binding.

localizedSummaries.zh-CN: 供 VSCode 与 AI 自动化使用的一次性资源构建任务；仅处理已有输入并在相邻目录写入输出， 不创建输入目录，也不改变 Visual Studio 的 `startWatch` 绑定。
localizedSummaries.en: One-time asset build task for VSCode and AI automation; it processes existing inputs and writes adjacent outputs without creating input directories or changing the Visual Studio `startWatch` binding.
